Function SIAc_AjouterEmploye(pnd_Acti As NotesDocument, pnd_Empl As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'ajouter un client à une activité '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_CodeActivite As String Dim v_NoInvite As Variant Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_Nom As String Dim v_Courriel As Variant Dim nd_Invi As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim v_MessageConfirmation As String
' Initialisations If Not SIAc_Initialisations Then Exit Function End If
' Validation - Vérifie si déja inscrit Set ndc = SIAc_RechercheInscription(pnd_Acti, pnd_Empl)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd_Invi = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Courriel = xEvaluate(|@Name([ABBREVIATE]; Empl_NotesID)|, pnd_Empl) v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_NomEmploye", ""))
' Ne pas permettre inscription si invité à même nom et courriel que pnd If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") = v_Courriel And xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_NomInvite", "") = v_Nom Then
If xLangue = "FR" Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 209, "", "L'employé"), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 209, "", "The employee"), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
Exit Function End If
' Si même courriel ou même nom afficher message de confirmation If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") = v_Courriel Or _ xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_NomInvite", "") = v_Nom Then
v_MessageConfirmation = xGDK_xMessage("SIPJ", 93, "", "") & Chr(13) & Chr(13)
If xLangue = "FR" Then If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Prenom : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Nom : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Courriel : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") & Chr(13) End If Else If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Last Name : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "First Name : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Email : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") & Chr(13) End If
End If
If v_MessageConfirmation <> "" Then If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 10, "", ""), v_MessageConfirmation) <> 1 Then Exit Function End If End If
End If
Loop
End If
' Créer le document de participant ' --------------------------------------------- Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_xSIAc) nd.Form = "F_Invi" v_CodeActivite = xVar(pnd_Acti, "Acti_CodeActivite", "") v_NoInvite = Evaluate(|@Right(@Unique; 6)|) nd.Cle = v_CodeActivite & ";" & v_NoInvite(0) nd.Description = xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_NomEmploye", "")
' Invité nd.Invi_CodeActivite = v_CodeActivite nd.Invi_NoInvite = v_NoInvite nd.Invi_Statut = "10" nd.Invi_StatutDescFR = "Nouveau" nd.Invi_Prenom = Trim(xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_Prenom", "")) nd.Invi_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_Nom", "")) nd.Invi_NomInvite = Trim(xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_NomEmploye", "")) nd.Invi_Titre = "" nd.Invi_Langue = "FR" nd.Invi_LangueDescFR = xGDK_xDescTabl(xVar(nd, "Invi_Langue", "FR"), "ISO639-1xFR", False) nd.Invi_Fonction = xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_DescDepartement", "") nd.Invi_Telephone = "" nd.Invi_TelephoneExt = xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_PosteTelephonique", "") nd.Invi_Courriel = Evaluate(|@Name([ABBREVIATE]; Empl_NotesID)|, pnd_Empl) nd.Invi_TypeInvite = "E" nd.Origine = xGDK_xVarNDB(gndb_SIAc.Title, "NDB_NomCourt", "", True) nd.OrigineCle = Trim(Cstr(xVar(pnd_Empl, "Empl_NoEmploye", "")))
' Historique nd.HistoDC = Now nd.HistoUC = gns_SIAc.Username Call nd.Save(True, False)
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAc, gc_Element_SIAc, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAc_AjouterProjeto(pnd_Acti As NotesDocument, pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'ajouter un client à une activité '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument Dim nd_Cont As NotesDocument Dim v_CleOrigine As String Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_CodeActivite As String Dim v_NoInvite As Variant Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_TypeInvite As String Dim v_NomClient As String Dim v_Nom As String Dim v_Courriel As Variant Dim nd_Invi As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim v_MessageConfirmation As String
' Initialisations SIAc_AjouterProjeto = False If Not SIAc_Initialisations Then Exit Function End If
Select Case xVar(pnd, "Form", "") Case "F_Clie" : Set nd_Clie = pnd Set nd_Cont = Nothing v_CleOrigine = xVar(pnd, "CleClient", "") v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd, "Clie_Nom", "")) v_Courriel = "" v_TypeInvite = "client" Case "F_Cont" : Set nd_Clie = gndb_SIAc.GetDocumentByUNID(xVar(pnd, "CleClient", "")) Set nd_Cont = pnd v_CleOrigine = xVar(pnd, "Cont_NoContact", "") v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd, "Cont_Contact", "")) v_Courriel = xVar(pnd, "Cont_Courriel", "") v_TypeInvite = "contact" Case Else: Messagebox "Type de document non supporté.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Function End Select
' Validation - Vérifie si déja inscrit Set ndc = SIAc_RechercheInscription(pnd_Acti, pnd)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd_Invi = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Ne pas permettre inscription si invité à même nom et courriel que pnd If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") = v_Courriel And xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_NomInvite", "") = v_Nom Then
If xLangue = "EN" Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 209, "", "The " & v_TypeInvite), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 209, "", "Le " & v_TypeInvite), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
Exit Function End If
' Si même courriel ou même nom afficher message de confirmation If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") = v_Courriel Or _ xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_NomInvite", "") = v_Nom Then
v_MessageConfirmation = xGDK_xMessage("SIPJ", 93, "", "") & Chr(13) & Chr(13)
v_NomClient = xEvaluate(|@If(!@IsNull(Invi_ClientNomInterne); Invi_ClientNomInterne; Invi_ClientNom1)|, nd_Invi)
If xLangue = "FR" Then
If v_NomClient <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Nom client : " & v_NomClient & Chr(13) & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Prenom : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Nom : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Courriel : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") & Chr(13) End If Else
If v_NomClient <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Client Name : " & xEvaluate(|@If(!@IsNull(Invi_ClientNomInterne); Invi_ClientNomInterne; Invi_ClientNom1)|, nd_Invi) & Chr(13) & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "First Name : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Prenom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Last Name : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Nom", "") & Chr(13) End If If xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") <> "" Then v_MessageConfirmation = v_MessageConfirmation & "Email : " & xVar(nd_Invi, "Invi_Courriel", "") & Chr(13) End If
End If
If v_MessageConfirmation <> "" Then If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 10, "", ""), v_MessageConfirmation) <> 1 Then Exit Function End If End If
End If
Loop
End If
' Créer le document de participant ' --------------------------------------------- Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_xSIAc) nd.Form = "F_Invi" v_CodeActivite = xVar(pnd_Acti, "Acti_CodeActivite", "") v_NoInvite = Evaluate(|@Right(@Unique; 6)|) nd.Cle = v_CodeActivite & ";" & v_NoInvite(0) nd.Description = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Contact", "") nd.Origine = xGDK_xVarNDB(gndb_SIAc.Title, "NDB_NomCourt", "", True) nd.OrigineCle = v_CleOrigine
' Invité nd.Invi_CodeActivite = v_CodeActivite nd.Invi_NoInvite = v_NoInvite nd.Invi_Statut = "10" nd.Invi_StatutDescFR = "Nouveau"
If Not (nd_Cont Is Nothing) Then nd.Invi_Prenom = Trim(xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Prenom", "")) nd.Invi_Nom = Trim(xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Nom", "")) nd.Invi_NomInvite = Trim(xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Contact", "")) nd.Invi_Titre = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Titre", "") nd.Invi_Langue = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Langue", "") nd.Invi_LangueDescFR = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_NomLangueFR", "") nd.Invi_Fonction = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_TitreProf", xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_FonctionFR", "")) nd.Invi_Telephone = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Telephone", "") nd.Invi_TelephoneExt = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_TelephoneExt", "") nd.Invi_Courriel = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Courriel", "") End If
' Client v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_NoClientFmt", "") If v_ClientNoFmt = "" Then nd.Invi_TypeInvite = "P" nd.Invi_ClientNom1 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Nom", "") nd.Invi_ClientNom2 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Division", "") nd.Invi_ClientAdresse1 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Adresse1", "") nd.Invi_ClientAdresse2 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Adresse2", "") nd.Invi_ClientVille = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Ville", "") nd.Invi_ClientProvince = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Province", "") nd.Invi_ClientCodePostal = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_CodePostal", "") nd.Invi_ClientTelephone1 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Telephone", "") nd.Invi_ClientTelephone2 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Telephone2", "") nd.Invi_ClientTelecopieur = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_Telecopieur", "") nd.Invi_InvitePar = xVarArray(nd_Clie, "Clie_ChargeCompteID") Else nd.Invi_TypeInvite = "C" nd.Invi_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt nd.Invi_ClientNom1 = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", True) nd.Invi_ClientNom2 = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom2", "", True) nd.Invi_ClientNomInterne = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "", True) nd.Invi_InvitePar = xVarArray(nd_Clie, "Clie_ChargeCompteID")
End If
' Historique nd.HistoDC = Now nd.HistoUC = gns_SIAc.Username Call nd.Save(True, False)
SIAc_AjouterProjeto = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAc, gc_Element_SIAc, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAc_RechercheInscription(pnd_Acti As NotesDocument, pnd As NotesDocument) As NotesDocumentCollection '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de valider si la resource est déja inscrit '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Invi21 As NotesView Dim v_CodeActivite As String Dim v_Nom As String Dim v_Courriel As Variant
'Initialisations Call xSIAc_Initialisation
Set SIAc_RechercheInscription = Nothing
Set nv_Invi21 = gndb_xSIAc.GetView("V_Invi21") v_CodeActivite = xVar(pnd_Acti, "Acti_CodeActivite", "")
Select Case xVar(pnd, "Form", "") Case "F_Clie" v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd, "Clie_Nom", "")) v_Courriel = "" Case "F_Cont" v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd, "Cont_Contact", "")) v_Courriel = xVar(pnd, "Cont_Courriel", "") Case "F_Empl" v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd, "Empl_NomEmploye", "")) v_Courriel = Evaluate(|@Name([ABBREVIATE]; Empl_NotesID)|, pnd) Case "F_Repr" v_Nom = Trim(xVar(pnd, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "")) v_Courriel = Evaluate(|@Name([ABBREVIATE]; Repr_NotesID)|, pnd) End Select
If Isarray(v_Courriel) Then Set SIAc_RechercheInscription = nv_Invi21.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_CodeActivite & ";" & Lcase(v_Courriel(0)), True) Elseif v_Courriel <> "" Then Set SIAc_RechercheInscription = nv_Invi21.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_CodeActivite & ";" & Lcase(v_Courriel), True) End If
If SIAc_RechercheInscription Is Nothing Then Set SIAc_RechercheInscription = nv_Invi21.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_CodeActivite & ";" & Lcase(v_Nom), True) Elseif SIAc_RechercheInscription.Count = 0 Then Set SIAc_RechercheInscription = nv_Invi21.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_CodeActivite & ";" & Lcase(v_Nom), True) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAc, gc_Element_SIAc, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Dim gns_VRepr As NotesSession Dim gndb_VRepr As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_VRepr As NotesUIWorkspace

Sub VRepr_Initialisations If gns_VRepr Is Nothing Then Set gns_VRepr = New NotesSession Set gndb_VRepr = gns_VRepr.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_VRepr = New NotesUIWorkspace End If End Sub

Sub VRepr_acActiviteAjouter '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'ajouter un ou plusieurs client ou contact à une activité de mise ' en marché. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As Notesdocumentcollection Dim nd_Acti As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_NbMaj As Integer Dim v_NbLus As Integer
Call VRepr_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VRepr.Unprocesseddocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' 2 - Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Sélection de l'activité à laquelle il faut ajouter les clients et contacts ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Set nd_Acti = SIAc_SelectionnerActivite If nd_Acti Is Nothing Then Exit Sub End If
' Ajouter les groupes aux documents sélectionnés ' ------------------------------------------------------------------ Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
If xVar(nd, "Rep_BASALT", "") <> 15 Then If SIAc_AjouterRepresentant(nd_Acti, nd) Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VRepr.CurrentView.Deselectall If v_NbLus = 0 Then Messagebox "Un représentant doit être sélectionné pour l'ajout à une activité.", 16, "Opération annulée" Else Print "Opération terminée. " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & " représentants ajoutés à l'activité." End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VRepr, gc_Element_VRepr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SIAc" ou "SIAc" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SIAc" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prop" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSIAc As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SIAc As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSIAc As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSIAc As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Acti_xSIAc As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Acti_xSIAc As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées ' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSIAc = "SIAc" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleActi_xSIAc = "Acti_Numero" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueActi_xSIAc = "V_Acti20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche
Sub xSIAc_Initialisation ' Initialisation des variables globales If gndb_xSIAc Is Nothing Then Set gndb_xSIAc = xGDK_xndbNDB(gc_NomBD_xSIAc) End If End Sub

Function xSIAc_xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable du profil de la base de documents.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSIAc_Initialisation
' Extraire le document de profil If gnd_Prof_SIAc Is Nothing Then Set gnd_Prof_SIAc = gndb_xSIAc.Getprofiledocument("F_Prof") End If
If gnd_Prof_SIAc Is Nothing Then xSIAc_xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle Else xSIAc_xVarProf = xVar(gnd_Prof_SIAc, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End If End Function

Function xSIAc_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSIAc_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSIAc, "V_Tabl20", gnvTabl_xSIAc, gndTabl_xSIAc) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSIAc_xndTabl = gndTabl_xSIAc End Function

Function xSIAc_xVarTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pNomVar As String, Byval pValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval pCache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document de type F_Tabl.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xndYYY) xSIAc_xVarTabl = xVar(xSIAc_xndTabl(pCle, pCache), pNomVar, pValeurNulle) ' Paramètres: 1 Notesdocument. Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le document ' recherché. ** Ne pas modifier ** End Function

Function xSIAc_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSIAc_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSIAc_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSIAc_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSIAc_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSIAc_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSIAc_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSIAc_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSIAc_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSIAc_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSIAc_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSIAc_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSIAc_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSIAc_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSIAc_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem
xSIAc_xValeurExisteTabl = False
If Not (xSIAc_xndTabl(p_Cle, True) Is Nothing) Then Set ni = gndTabl_xSIAc.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Valeurs") If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xSIAc_xValeurExisteTabl = True End If End If End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK"

Dim gns_SIAg As NotesSession Dim gndb_SIAg As NotesDatabase Dim gnd_Prof_SIAg As NotesDocument
Const g_ServeurDev_SIAg = "CN=Zulu/O=Serti Informatique"
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SIAg = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIAg = "SI_Agents"

Sub SIAg_ExecuterAgent(p_NomUsuel As String, p_NomAgent As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim na As Notesagent
' Vérifier que Amgr est disponible If Not SIAg_AmgrDisponible Then Print "Les agents ne sont pas autorisés pour l'instant... (" & p_NomUsuel & " : " & p_NomAgent & ")" Exit Sub End If
' Initialiser la base de documents If p_NomUsuel = "" Then Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Else Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB(p_NomUsuel) End If If ndb Is Nothing Then Print "La base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & " est introuvable. Exécution annulée... (" & p_NomAgent & ")" Exit Sub Elseif Not ndb.Isopen Then Print "La base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & " est introuvable. Exécution annulée... (" & p_NomAgent & ")" Exit Sub End If
' Extraire l'agent Set na = ndb.GetAgent(p_NomAgent) If na Is Nothing Then Print "L'agent " & p_NomAgent & " est introuvable dans la base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & ". Exécution annulée..." Exit Sub End If
' Exécuter l'agent Print "Lancement de l'agent " & p_NomAgent & " dans la base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & "." Call na.Run Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomUsuel & " : " & p_NomAgent, False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIAg_RetenirAmgr(p_Code As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v As Variant Dim nd As NotesDocument
SIAg_RetenirAmgr = False Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase
v = Evaluate(|@Right(@Unique; 6)|) p_Code = v(0) Set nd = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd.Code = p_Code Call nd.Save(True, False) Call nd.PutInFolder("D_Amgr", True)
SIAg_RetenirAmgr = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAg_RelacherAmgr(p_Code As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
SIAg_RelacherAmgr = False
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nv = ndb.GetView("D_Amgr") If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set nd = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing If nd.Code(0) = p_Code Then Call nd.Remove(True) SIAg_RelacherAmgr = True Exit Function End If
Set nd = nv.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAg_AmgrDisponible As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument
SIAg_AmgrDisponible = True
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nv = ndb.GetView("D_Amgr") If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set nd = nv.GetFirstDocument If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then SIAg_AmgrDisponible = False End If Exit Function
GererErreur: SIAg_AmgrDisponible = False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SIAg_Initialisations If gns_SIAg Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIAg = New Notessession Set gndb_SIAg = gns_SIAg.CurrentDatabase Set gnd_Prof_SIAg = gndb_SIAg.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof") End If End Sub

Function SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ServeurPrincipal As String
SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal = True
' Initialisations Call SIAg_Initialisations
If gndb_SIAg.Server <> g_ServeurDev_SIAg Then v_ServeurPrincipal = xVar(gnd_Prof_SIAg, "Prof_Serveur", "") If v_ServeurPrincipal <> "" Then If v_ServeurPrincipal <> gndb_SIAg.Server Then SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal = False End If End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Agents" Use "SI_Temp" Use "x_NAB" Use "x_SIEm" Use "x_SIRR"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SISg"

Sub Initialize '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Cette agent Mis à jour les signatures des employés/représentant de Serti '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As Notesview Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_NbLus As Integer Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
' Sécurité If Not SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal Then Print "Le serveur sur lequel cet agent s'exécute n'est pas le serveur principal." End End If
Print "Début"
' Initialisation Call A_Initialisations
' Boucler sur tous les représentants Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Repr20") Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd)
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
' Mettre à jour le carnet d'adresses de Serti v_Statut = xVar(nd, "Repr_Statut", "") If v_Statut = "10" Then ' Mettre à jour la signature de la base de courriel If A_MajSignature(nd) then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
End If Loop
Print "Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.Currentdatabase End If
End Sub

Function A_SignatureRepresentant (p_Signature As String, pnd_Prof As NotesDocument, pnd_Depa As NotesDocument, pnd_SDep As NotesDocument, _ pnd_Repr As NotesDocument, pnd_SISg As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_PrSg20 As NotesView Dim nv_PrSg21 As NotesView
Dim nrti_Signature As NotesRichTextItem Dim i As Integer Dim v_Element As String Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem
Dim nd_SISgProfil As NotesDocument
Dim v_SISgItem As String Dim v_SgRepr As String Dim v_TypeSignature As String Dim v_ProfileSignature As String 'No Profile
A_SignatureRepresentant = False
Set nv_PrSg20 = gndb_xSIEm.Getview("V_PrSg20") 'Catégorisée par type E/I Set nv_PrSg21 = gndb_xSIEm.Getview("V_PrSg21") 'Triée par NoProfile
If p_Signature = "E" Then v_TypeSignature = "Repr_ProfilSignatureExterne" v_SgRepr = "Repr_SignatureExterne" v_SISgItem = "SISg_SignatureExterne" Else v_TypeSignature = "Repr_ProfilSignatureInterne" v_SgRepr = "Repr_SignatureInterne" v_SISgItem = "SISg_SignatureInterne" End If
' Extraire le nom du profile signature a utiliser a partir du doc Repr v_ProfileSignature = xVar(pnd_Repr, v_TypeSignature, "")
If v_ProfileSignature <> "" Then
' Profil signature Représentant(e) specifié Call nv_PrSg20.Refresh Set nd_SISgProfil = nv_PrSg20.GetDocumentByKey (Cint(v_ProfileSignature)) 'Interger vs string field value vs column value
Else
' Profil non specifié, on utilise le 1er profile disponible Call nv_PrSg21.Refresh Set nd_SISgProfil = nv_PrSg21.Getdocumentbykey(p_Signature)
End If
Call pnd_Repr.RemoveItem(v_SgRepr) Set nrti_Signature = New NotesRichTextItem(pnd_Repr, v_SgRepr)
For i = 1 To 9 Set nrti = Nothing v_Element = xVar(nd_SISgProfil, "PrSg_SignatureElement" & Cstr(i), "") If v_Element = "" Then Exit For End If
Select Case Left(v_Element, 1) Case "C" : ' Compagnie Set nrti = pnd_Prof.GetFirstItem("Prof_SignatureElement" & Right(v_Element, 1)) Case "D" : ' Département Set nrti = pnd_Depa.GetFirstItem("Depa_SignatureElement" & Right(v_Element, 1)) Case "S" : ' Sous-département If Not (pnd_SDep Is Nothing) Then Set nrti = pnd_SDep.GetFirstItem("SDep_SignatureElement" & Right(v_Element, 1)) End If Case "E" : ' Représentant Set nrti = pnd_Repr.GetFirstItem("Repr_SignatureElement" & Right(v_Element, 1)) End Select
If Not (nrti Is Nothing) Then If nrti.Getunformattedtext <> "" Or nrti.ValueLength > 256 Then If A_SignatureRepresentant Then Call nrti_Signature.AddNewLine(1) End If Call nrti_Signature.AppendRTItem(nrti) A_SignatureRepresentant = True End If End If Next
Call nrti_Signature.Compact
If Not (pnd_SISg Is Nothing) Then Call pnd_SISg.RemoveItem(v_SISgItem) Call nrti_Signature.CopyItemToDocument(pnd_SISg, v_SISgItem) End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_SignatureCourriel(pnd_SISg As NotesDocument, pnd_CalProf As NotesDocument) As Boolean '============================================================= '=============== Maj du profil de la base de courriel ================== '============================================================= On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nrti_Rich As NotesRichTextItem Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_SignatureTexte As String Dim s As String
A_SignatureCourriel = False v_Maj = False
'=============== Signature Rich ================== Set nrti = pnd_SISg.Getfirstitem("SISg_SignatureExterne") If pnd_CalProf.HasItem("Signature_Rich") Then Set nrti_Rich = pnd_CalProf.GetFirstItem("Signature_Rich") If nrti.ValueLength <> nrti_Rich.ValueLength _ Or Fulltrim(nrti.Text) <> Fulltrim(nrti_Rich.Text) Then Call nrti_Rich.Remove v_Maj = True End If Else v_Maj = True End If If v_Maj Then Call nrti.CopyItemToDocument(pnd_CalProf, "Signature_Rich") End If
'=============== Signature Web / Texte ================== Set nrti = pnd_SISg.Getfirstitem("SISg_SignatureInterne") v_SignatureTexte = nrti.GetUnformattedText If v_SignatureTexte <> xVar(pnd_CalProf, "Signature_Texte", "") _ Or v_SignatureTexte <> xVar(pnd_CalProf, "Signature", "") _ Or v_SignatureTexte <> xVar(pnd_CalProf, "Signature_1", "") Then pnd_CalProf.Signature_Texte = v_SignatureTexte pnd_CalProf.Signature = v_SignatureTexte pnd_CalProf.Signature_1 = v_SignatureTexte v_Maj = True End If
A_SignatureCourriel = v_Maj Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_ndbCourriel(p_NotesId As String, pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ServeurCourriel As String Dim v_FichierCourriel As String
A_ndbCourriel = False If p_NotesId = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Extraire la base de courriel de l'utilisateur v_ServeurCourriel = xNAB_xVarPerson(p_NotesId, "MailServer", "", True) v_FichierCourriel = xNAB_xVarPerson(p_NotesId, "MailFile", "", True) If v_FichierCourriel <> "" And Lcase(Right(v_FichierCourriel, 4)) <> ".nsf" Then v_FichierCourriel = v_FichierCourriel & ".nsf" End If Set pndb = gns_A.GetDatabase(v_ServeurCourriel, v_FichierCourriel, False) If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not pndb.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If
' Vérifier le modèle utilisé par la base de documents If pndb.DesignTemplateName = "" Or Left(Lcase(pndb.DesignTemplateName), 11) <> "si courriel" Then Print "Le fichier de courriel de " & pndb.Title & " n'utilise pas le modèle SI Courriel (" & pndb.DesignTemplateName & ")." Exit Function End If
A_ndbCourriel = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NotesId, False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_MajSignature(pnd_Repr As NotesDocument) As boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd_Depa As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim ndb_Courriel As NotesDatabase Dim nd_SISg As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_SignatureInterne As String Dim nd_CalProf As NotesDocument Dim nrti_Rich As NotesRichTextItem Dim v_Signature_Rich As String Dim s As String
A_MajSignature = False ' Si l'utilisateur n'a pas de signature, sortir If Not pnd_Repr.HasItem("Repr_SignatureElement1") Then Exit Function End If Set nrti = pnd_Repr.GetFirstItem("Repr_SignatureElement1") If nrti.Text = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Extraire les documents requis Call xSIEm_Initialisation Set nv = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_AdmT") Set nd_Prof = nv.GetDocumentByKey("F_SISg", True) 'document Admin\Signature defini dans la base SI Employes Set nd_Depa = xSIEm_xndDepa(xVar(pnd_Repr, "Repr_NoDepartement", ""), True)
'=============== Signature Notes ================== ' Extraire / créer le document de signature de l'utilisateur
If xGDK_TypeNDBCourante = "P" Then ' Environnement de production If Not a_ndbCourriel(xVar(pnd_Repr, "Repr_NotesId", ""), ndb_Courriel) Then Exit Function End if Set nv = ndb_Courriel.GetView("V_AdmT") If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set nd_SISg = nv.GetDocumentByKey("F_SISg") If nd_SISg Is Nothing Then Set nd_SISg = New NotesDocument(ndb_Courriel) nd_SISg.Form = "F_SISg" nd_SISg.ExcludeFromView = Evaluate(|"A" : "D"|) nd_SISg.HistoDC = Now nd_SISg.HistoDM = Now v_Maj = True Elseif xVar(nd_SISg, "SISg_Origine", "") = "E" Then v_Maj = False Print "La signature de " & xVar(pnd_Repr, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") & " provient de SI Employés." Else v_Date = xVar(nd_SISg, "HistoDM", Today) If xVar(pnd_Repr, "HistoDM", xVar(pnd_Repr, "HistoDC", Today)) > v_Date _ Or xVar(nd_Prof, "HistoDM", xVar(nd_Prof, "HistoDC", Today)) > v_Date _ Or xVar(nd_Depa, "HistoDM", xVar(nd_Prof, "HistoDC", Today)) > v_Date Then v_Maj = True End If End If Else ' Environnement de tests ou local Set ndb_Courriel = Nothing Set nd_SISg = Nothing v_Maj = True End if
If v_Maj Then ' Signature interne Call A_SignatureRepresentant ("I", nd_Prof, nd_Depa, Nothing, pnd_Repr, nd_SISg)
' Signature externe Call A_SignatureRepresentant ("E", nd_Prof, nd_Depa, Nothing, pnd_Repr, nd_SISg)
If Not (nd_SISg Is Nothing) Then nd_SISg.SISg_Origine = "R" nd_SISg.HistoDM = Now nd_SISg.HistoUM = "A_SISg" Call nd_SISg.Save(True, False) End If
Call pnd_Repr.Save(True, False) A_MajSignature = True Print "Signature de " & xVar(pnd_Repr, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") & " mise à jour." End If
If Not (ndb_Courriel Is Nothing) Then Set nd_CalProf = ndb_Courriel.GetProfileDocument("CalendarProfile") If nd_CalProf Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
' Signature iNotes (Web Mail) v_Maj = A_SignatureCourriel(nd_SISg, nd_CalProf) Or v_Maj
'=============== Sauvegarde du profil ================== If v_Maj _ Or xVar(nd_CalProf, "EnableSignature", "") <> "1" _ Or xVar(nd_CalProf, "SignatureOption", "") <> "3" Then nd_CalProf.EnableSignature = "1" nd_CalProf.SignatureOption = "3" Call nd_CalProf.Save(True, False) End If End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), xVar(pnd_Repr, "Repr_NotesId", ""), False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SIEm" Use "x_SIRR"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_SISg As Notessession Dim gndb_SISg As Notesdatabase
Const gc_Signet_SISg = "[Signature]"
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SISg = "SL" Const gc_Element_SISg = "SI_Signatures"

Sub SISg_hsInsererImageSignature(p_NomItem As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim nuid As Notesuidocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_SIDo As NotesDocument Dim v_NomImage As String Dim v_TypeImage As String Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject Dim v_CheminFichier As String
' Initialisations Call SISg_Initialisations
' Sélectionner l'image Set ndc = nuiws.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_SISg.Server, gndb_SISg.FilePath, "V_SIDo20", _ "Insertion d'une image", "Sélectionnez l'image à insérer.") If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If Set nd_SIDo = ndc.GetFirstDocument v_TypeImage = xVar(nd_SIDo, "SIDo_TypeNotes", "") If v_TypeImage <> "GIF Image" And v_TypeImage <> "JPEG Image" Then Messagebox "Le document sélectionné n'est pas d'un type permis.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
' Extraire l'image If nd_SIDo.HasItem("SIDo_Document") Then Set nrti = nd_SIDo.GetFirstItem("SIDo_Document") If Isarray(nrti.EmbeddedObjects) Then Set neo = nrti.EmbeddedObjects(0) v_NomImage = neo.Name v_CheminFichier = Environ("Temp") & "\" & v_NomImage On Error 75 Resume Next Kill v_CheminFichier Call neo.ExtractFile(v_CheminFichier) Else Messagebox "L'image " & v_NomImage & " n'est pas disponible. (2)", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If Else Messagebox "L'image " & v_NomImage & " n'est pas disponible. (3)", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
' Ajouter l'image au document Set nuid = nuiws.currentDocument Call nuid.GotoField(p_NomItem) Call nuid.Import(v_TypeImage, v_CheminFichier) Kill v_CheminFichier Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SISg_ExtraireSignatureRep(p_NoEmploye As Variant, p_Projeto As String) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'extraire la signature du document de l'employée. 'Paramètre: ' pnd_NoEmploye : Variant. Le numéro de l'employé. Si null, on utilise le numéro de ' l'utilisateur courant. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SIRR As NotesDocument Dim nrti_Rep As NotesRichTextItem
' Initialisation SISg_ExtraireSignatureRep = False
' Extraire le fiche du représentant If p_NoEmploye = "" Then Set nd_SIRR = xSIRR_xndRepr_Id(gns_SISg.Username, p_Projeto) Else Set nd_SIRR = xSIRR_xndRepr(p_NoEmploye, True) End If If nd_SIRR Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
If nd_SIRR.HasItem("Repr_SignatureExterne") Then Set nrti_Rep = nd_SIRR.GetFirstItem("Repr_SignatureExterne") If nrti_Rep.GetUnformattedText <> "" Then SISg_ExtraireSignatureRep = True If p_NoEmploye = "" Then p_NoEmploye = xVar(nd_SIRR, "Repr_NoRepresentant", "") End If End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SISg_EffacerSignet(pnuid As NotesuiDocument, p_Body As String) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'effacer le signet. 'Paramètre: ' p_Body : String. Le nom du champ richtext ou ajouter la signature. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisation SISg_EffacerSignet = False Call SISg_Initialisations
If Instr(pnuid.FieldGetText(p_Body), gc_Signet_SISg) > 0 Then Call pnuid.GotoField(p_Body) Call pnuid.FindString(gc_Signet_SISg) Call pnuid.InsertText(" ") End If
SISg_EffacerSignet = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIRR(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_NoRepresentant As String, p_Body As String) As Boolean ' p_Signature : I = Interne, E=Externe On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim script As String
SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIRR = False xSIRR_Initialisations
script = | Dim s As New NotesSession Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim nv as NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim wksp As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uiDoc As NotesUIDocument
Set db = s.GetDatabase("| & gndb_xSIRR.Server & |", "| & gndb_xSIRR.FilePath & |", False) Set nv = db.GetView("V_Repr20") Set nd = nv.GetDocumentByKey("| & p_NoRepresentant & |", true) if not (nd is Nothing) then Set uiDoc = wksp.CurrentDocument If nd.HasItem("Repr_SignatureExterne") Then Call uiDoc.ImportItem(nd, "Repr_SignatureExterne") End If End if |
' Insérer la signature dans le message If Instr(pnuid_Source.FieldGetText(p_Body), gc_Signet_SISg) = 0 Then Call pnuid_Source.FieldAppendText(p_Body, gc_Signet_SISg) End If Call pnuid_Source.GotoField(p_Body) Call pnuid_Source.FindString(gc_Signet_SISg)
Execute(script)
pnuid_Source.Document.SI_Signature = "1" SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIRR = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SISg_Initialisations If gns_SISg Is Nothing Then Set gns_SISg = New Notessession Set gndb_SISg = gns_SISg.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Function SISg_ExtraireSignature(p_NoEmploye As Variant) As String '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'extraire la signature du document de l'employée. 'Paramètre: ' pnd_NoEmploye : Variant. Le numéro de l'employé. Si null, on utilise le numéro de ' l'utilisateur courant. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisation SISg_ExtraireSignature = "" Call SISg_Initialisations
' Extraire le document de l'employé dans SI Employées If SISg_ExtraireSignatureEmpl(p_NoEmploye) Then SISg_ExtraireSignature = "E" Exit Function End If ' Si pas trouvé dans SI Employés, vérifie dans SI Représentants If SISg_ExtraireSignatureRep(p_NoEmploye, "0") Then SISg_ExtraireSignature = "R" Exit Function End If ' Si pas trouvé dans SI Employés, vérifie dans SI Représentants If SISg_ExtraireSignatureRep(p_NoEmploye, "60") Then SISg_ExtraireSignature = "R" Exit Function End If ' Si pas trouvé dans SI Employés, vérifie dans SI Représentants If SISg_ExtraireSignatureRep(p_NoEmploye, "62") Then SISg_ExtraireSignature = "R" Exit Function End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SISg_AjouterSignature(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_NoEmploye As Variant, p_Body As String) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'ajouter une signature au message. La signature provient du document de l'employée. 'Paramètre: ' pnuid_Source : NotesUIDocument. Le document courant dans laquelle on insert le signet. ' pnd_NoEmploye : Variant. Le numéro de l'employé. Si null, on utilise le numéro de l'utilisateur courant. ' p_Body : String. Le nom du champ richtext ou ajouter la signature. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim v_Type As String
' Initialisation SISg_AjouterSignature = False Call SISg_Initialisations
' Vérifier que l'indicateur de signature est présent If Instr(pnuid_Source.FieldGetText(p_Body), gc_Signet_SISg) = 0 Then If pnuid_Source.CurrentField = p_Body Then If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Signature", xGDK_xMessage("SI", 177, "", "")) Then Call pnuid_Source.InsertText(gc_Signet_SISg) Else Exit Function End If Else Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 178, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If
' Insérer la signature dans le message v_Type = SISg_ExtraireSignature(p_NoEmploye) If v_Type = "E" Then If Not SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIEm(pnuid_Source, Cstr(p_NoEmploye), p_Body) Then ' Erreur lors de l'insertion de la signature - Voulez-vous envoyer le courriel quand même ? If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Signature", xGDK_xMessage("SI", 179, "", "")) <> 1 Then Exit Function End If End If Elseif v_Type = "R" Then If Not SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIRR(pnuid_Source, Cstr(p_NoEmploye), p_Body) Then ' Erreur lors de l'insertion de la signature - Voulez-vous envoyer le courriel quand même ? If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Signature", xGDK_xMessage("SI", 179, "", "")) <> 1 Then Exit Function End If End If Else ' Impossible de générer la signature - Voulez-vous envoyer le courriel quand même ? If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Signature", xGDK_xMessage("SI", 180, "", "")) <> 1 Then Exit Function End If End If
' Effacer le signet SISg_AjouterSignature = SISg_EffacerSignet(pnuid_Source, p_Body) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SISg_ExtraireSignatureEmpl(p_NoEmploye As Variant) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'extraire la signature du document de l'employée. 'Paramètre: ' pnd_NoEmploye : Variant. Le numéro de l'employé. Si null, on utilise le numéro de ' l'utilisateur courant. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Empl As NotesDocument Dim nrti_Empl As NotesRichTextItem
' Initialisation SISg_ExtraireSignatureEmpl = False
' Extraire le document de l'employé If p_NoEmploye = "" Then Set nd_Empl = xSIEm_xndEmpl_Id(gns_SISg.Username, True) Else Set nd_Empl = xSIEm_xndEmpl(p_NoEmploye , True) End If If nd_Empl Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
If nd_Empl.HasItem("Empl_SignatureExterne") Then Set nrti_Empl = nd_Empl.GetFirstItem("Empl_SignatureExterne") If nrti_Empl.GetUnformattedText <> "" Then SISg_ExtraireSignatureEmpl = True If p_NoEmploye = "" Then p_NoEmploye = xVar(nd_Empl, "Empl_NoEmploye", "") End If End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIEm(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_NoEmploye As String, p_Body As String) As Boolean ' p_Signature : I = Interne, E=Externe On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim script As String
SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIEm = False Call xSIEm_Initialisation

pnuid_Source.Document.SI_Signature = "1" SISg_InsererSignatureExterne_SIEm = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SISg_InsererSignet(pnuid As NotesUIDocument, p_Body As String) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'insérer le signet dans le message. 'Paramètre: ' p_Body : String. Le nom du champ richtext ou ajouter la signature. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisation SISg_InsererSignet = False Call SISg_Initialisations
' Insérer le signet dans le message Call pnuid.GotoField(p_Body) Call pnuid.inserttext(Chr(10) & Chr(10) & gc_Signet_SISg & Chr(10)) Call pnuid.GotoField(p_Body)
SISg_InsererSignet = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISg, gc_Element_SISg, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "SI_Insertions" Use "SI_NAB" Use "x_SIEm" Use "x_SIRR"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
Dim ga_GroupesExistants_A As Variant
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_MajJ"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Print "Début"
' Initialisation Call A_Initialisations
' Traiter les départements Call A_TraiterDepartements
' Traiter les équipes actives Call A_TraiterEquipes
' Traiter les représentants actifs Call A_TraiterRepresentants Call A_SynchroniserNAB_rpTous
' Supprimer les groupes inutilisés Call A_SupprimerGroupes
Print "Fin" Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_SupprimerGroupes ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Synchroniser le groupe ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v As Variant Dim i As Integer
If Isarray(ga_GroupesExistants_A) Then For i = Lbound(ga_GroupesExistants_A) To Ubound(ga_GroupesExistants_A) If ga_GroupesExistants_A(i) <> "" Then Call NAB_SupprimerGroupe(ga_GroupesExistants_A(i)) Else Exit For End If Next End If Exit Sub

Function A_SynchroniserNAB(pnd As NotesDocument, pndc_NoId As NotesDocumentCollection, pndc_Dir As NotesDocumentCollection) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NotesId As String Dim nd_NAB As NotesDocument
A_SynchroniserNAB = False If xVar(pnd, "Repr_PasDeNotesId", "") = "1" Then Exit Function End If
' Si le représentant a un Notes Id ' -------------------------------------------- v_NotesId = xVar(pnd, "Repr_NotesID", "") If v_NotesId <> "" Then ' Si NotesId pas trouvé dans le NAB, l'effacer Set nd_NAB = xNAB_xndPerson(v_NotesId, True) If nd_NAB Is Nothing Then v_NotesId = "" pnd.Repr_NotesID = v_NotesId
A_SynchroniserNAB = True Else If SIIx_MajItem(pnd, "Repr_Courriel", xVar2(nd_NAB, "MailAddress", "InternetAddress", ""), False) Then A_SynchroniserNAB = True End If End If End If
' Si le représentant n'a pas de Notes Id ' ---------------------------------------------------- If v_NotesId = "" Then ' Rechercher le Notes Id du représentant dans le NAB Set nd_NAB = xNAB_xndPersonCN(xVar(pnd, "Repr_NomRepresentant", ""), True)
' Si le représentant n'existe pas dans le NAB, ajouter le dans l'array k If nd_NAB Is Nothing Then Call pndc_NoId.AddDocument(pnd)
' Si le représentant existe dans le NAB, mettre à jour son Notes Id et le type Else v_NotesId = xVarElem(nd_NAB, "FullName", 0, "") pnd.Repr_NotesID = v_NotesId pnd.Repr_Courriel = xVar2(nd_NAB, "MailAddress", "InternetAddress", "") A_SynchroniserNAB = True End If ElseIf xVarContient(pnd, "Repr_SDSPropositions", "DIR") then Call pndc_Dir.AddDocument(pnd) End If
' Mettre à jour l'ACL du fichier de courriels du représentant If Not (nd_NAB Is Nothing) Then Call A_MajACL_Courriel(nd_NAB) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub A_EnvoyerCourriel(pndc As NotesdocumentCollection) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Pour retourner un courriel '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim s As String Dim a_LargeurColonnes(2) As Double Dim a_Couleurs(1) As Variant Dim a_Entetes(2) As String Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument
Redim a_Valeurs(pndc.Count - 1, 2) As Variant
' Définir les valeurs du tableau Set nd = pndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing a_Valeurs(i,0) = xVar(nd, "Repr_NoRepresentant", "") a_Valeurs(i,1) = xVar(nd, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") s = xVar(nd, "Repr_NoDepartement", "") a_Valeurs(i,2) = s & " - " & xSIRR_xVarDepa(s, "Depa_NomDepartement", "", True) i = i + 1
Set nd = pndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
' Définir les colonnes du tableau a_LargeurColonnes(0) = 2 a_LargeurColonnes(1) = 8 a_LargeurColonnes(2) = 8
' Définir les colonnes du tableau a_Couleurs(0) = COLOR_WHITE a_Couleurs(1) = Evaluate("236:231:213")
' Définir les entêtes du tableau a_Entetes(0) = "No" a_Entetes(1) = "Nom" a_Entetes(2) = "Département"
' Préparer et envoyer le courriel ' ----------------------------------------- ' Préparer le message Set nd = Nothing Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd, "A_SNAB", "FR", "", "", "", False, "")
' Construire le tableau des employés Call SICT_AjouterTableau(nd_Courriel, "", a_Valeurs, "", a_Couleurs, a_LargeurColonnes, a_Entetes, 0)
' Envoyer le message Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_TraiterEquipes ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Mettre à jour les groupes (NAB) des départements ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As Notesview Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_NomGroupe As String Dim a_Membres As Variant Dim s As String
' Boucler sur toutes les équipes Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Equi20") Call nv.Refresh Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd) v_NomGroupe = xVar(nd, "Equi_NomGroupeNAB", "")
' Équipe active If xVar(nd, "Equi_Statut", "") = "10" Then ' Si le département est associé à un groupe du NAB If v_NomGroupe <> "" Then ' Extraire la liste des membres du département a_Membres = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Repr22"; Equi_NoEquipe; 3); "")))|, nd)
' Synchroniser le groupe du NAB Call A_SynchroniserGroupe(v_NomGroupe, "Équipe " & xVar(nd, "Equi_NomEquipe", ""), a_Membres) End If
' Équipe inactive Else Call NAB_SupprimerGroupe(v_NomGroupe) End If
' Correction erreurs de transfert LEI (accents) s = xVar(nd, "Equi_NomEquipe", "") If s <> Trim(s) Then nd.Equi_NomEquipe = Trim(s) Call nd.Save(True, False) End If Loop Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_MajACL_Courriel(pnd_NAB As NotesDocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomBase As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nacl As NotesACL Dim nacle As NotesACLEntry Dim v_MajACL As Boolean
If xVar(pnd_NAB, "MailSystem", "") <> "1" Then Exit Sub End If
' Extraire la base de courriel de l'employé v_NomBase = xVar(pnd_NAB, "MailFile", "") If v_NomBase = "" Then Exit Sub End If If Lcase(Right(v_NomBase, 4)) <> ".nsf" Then v_NomBase = v_NomBase & ".nsf" End If Set ndb = gns_A.GetDatabase(xVar(pnd_NAB, "MailServer", ""), v_NomBase, False) If ndb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub End If Set nacl = ndb.ACL
' Maximum internet access = Editor If nacl.InternetLevel <> ACLLEVEL_EDITOR Then nacl.InternetLevel = ACLLEVEL_EDITOR v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "Admin_Courriels" --> Manager access Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("Admin_Courriels") If nacle Is Nothing Then Set nacle = nacl.Createaclentry("Admin_Courriels", ACLLEVEL_MANAGER) nacle.UserType = ACLTYPE_PERSON_GROUP v_MajACL = True Elseif nacle.Level < ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Or nacle.Usertype <> ACLTYPE_PERSON_GROUP Then nacle.Level = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER nacle.UserType = ACLTYPE_PERSON_GROUP v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "Server Admins" --> Manager access Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("Server Admins") If nacle Is Nothing Then Set nacle = nacl.Createaclentry("Server Admins", ACLLEVEL_MANAGER) nacle.UserType = ACLTYPE_PERSON_GROUP v_MajACL = True Elseif nacle.Level < ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Or nacle.Usertype <> ACLTYPE_PERSON_GROUP Then nacle.Level = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER nacle.UserType = ACLTYPE_PERSON_GROUP v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "LocalDomainServers" --> Manager access Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("LocalDomainServers") If nacle Is Nothing Then Set nacle = nacl.Createaclentry("LocalDomainServers", ACLLEVEL_MANAGER) nacle.UserType = ACLTYPE_SERVER_GROUP v_MajACL = True Elseif nacle.Level < ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Or nacle.Usertype <> ACLTYPE_SERVER_GROUP Then nacle.Level = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER nacle.UserType = ACLTYPE_SERVER_GROUP v_MajACL = True End If
' "-Default-" --> No access Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("-Default-") If nacle.Level > ACLLEVEL_NOACCESS _ Or nacle.IsPublicReader _ Or nacle.IsPublicWriter _ Or nacle.CanReplicateOrCopyDocuments Then nacle.Level = ACLLEVEL_NOACCESS nacle.IsPublicReader = False nacle.IsPublicWriter = False nacle.CanReplicateOrCopyDocuments = False v_MajACL = True End If
' Créer "Anonymous" s'il n'existe pas --> No Access Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("Anonymous") If nacle Is Nothing Then Set nacle = nacl.Createaclentry("Anonymous", ACLLEVEL_NOACCESS) nacle.IsPublicReader = False nacle.IsPublicWriter = False nacle.CanReplicateOrCopyDocuments = False v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "Accès Restreint" --> Supprimer Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("Accès Restreint") If Not (nacle Is Nothing) Then Call nacle.Remove v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "Developpement Notes" --> Supprimer Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("Developpement Notes") If Not (nacle Is Nothing) Then Call nacle.Remove v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "Developement Notes" --> Supprimer Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("Developement Notes") If Not (nacle Is Nothing) Then Call nacle.Remove v_MajACL = True End If
' Groupe "*/Serti Informatique" --> Supprimer Set nacle = nacl.GetEntry("*/O=Serti Informatique") If Not (nacle Is Nothing) Then On Error 4005 Resume Next Call nacle.Remove v_MajACL = True End If
If v_MajACL Then Call nacl.Save End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.Currentdatabase
' Construire la liste des groupes existants Call NAB_Initialisations ga_GroupesExistants_A = Evaluate(|@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_NAB.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_NAB.Filepath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_Group21"; "*SI Représentants"; 2)|) End If End Sub

Sub A_TraiterRepresentants On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As Notesview Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim ndc_NoId As NotesDocumentCollection Dim s As String Dim ndc_Dir As NotesDocumentCollection Dim a_Membres As Variant
Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Repr20") Set ndc_NoId = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey("*BiDoN*", True) Set ndc_Dir = nv.Parent.CreateDocumentCollection
' Boucler sur touts les représentants Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd) v_Statut = xVar(nd, "Repr_Statut", "") v_Maj = False
' Mettre à jour le carnet d'adresses de Serti If v_Statut = "10" Then If A_SynchroniserNAB(nd, ndc_NoId, ndc_Dir) Then v_Maj = True End If End If
' Correction erreurs de transfert LEI (accents) s = xVar(nd, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") If s <> Trim(s) Then nd.Repr_NomRepresentant = Trim(s) v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj Then Call nd.Save(True, False) End If Loop
' S'il y a des représentants sans NotesId, envoyer un courriel aux administrateurs If ndc_NoId.Count > 0 Then Call A_EnvoyerCourriel(ndc_NoId) End If
' Maj le groupe des directeurs If ndc_Dir.Count > 0 Then a_Membres = xVarCollection(ndc_Dir, "Repr_NotesID") Call A_SynchroniserGroupe("rpSDS_Dir", "Tous les directeurs SDS", a_Membres) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function A_SynchroniserGroupe(p_Nom As String, p_Description As String, pa_Membres As Variant) As Boolean ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Synchroniser le groupe ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v As Variant Dim i As Integer
A_SynchroniserGroupe = NAB_SynchroniserGroupe(p_Nom, p_Description, "*SI Représentants", pa_Membres)
If Isarray(ga_GroupesExistants_A) Then v = Arraygetindex(ga_GroupesExistants_A, p_Nom) If Not Isnull(v) Then For i = v + 1 To Ubound(ga_GroupesExistants_A) If ga_GroupesExistants_A(i) <> "" Then ga_GroupesExistants_A(i - 1) = ga_GroupesExistants_A(i) Else Exit For End If Next ga_GroupesExistants_A(i - 1) = "" End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub A_TraiterDepartements ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Mettre à jour les groupes (NAB) des départements ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur

' Si le département est associé à un groupe du NAB v_NomGroupe = xVar(nd, "Depa_NomGroupeNAB", "") If v_NomGroupe <> "" Then ' Extraire la liste des membres du département a_Membres = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Repr23"; Depa_NoDepartement; 3); "") : Depa_NotesIds))|, nd)
' Synchroniser le groupe du NAB Call A_SynchroniserGroupe(v_NomGroupe, "Département " & xVar(nd, "Depa_NomDepartement", ""), a_Membres) End If Loop Exit Sub

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIIx = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIIx = "SI_Insertions"

Sub SIIx_AppendItemValue(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurAjouter As Variant Dim a_ValeurActuelle As Variant
' Formatter la valeur à ajouter If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then a_ValeurAjouter = Fulltrim(p_Valeur) If a_ValeurAjouter(0) = "" Then Exit Sub ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter End If Elseif p_Valeur = "" Then ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter Exit Sub Else a_ValeurAjouter = p_Valeur End If
' Ajouter la valeur à l'item du document a_ValeurActuelle = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Isarray(a_ValeurActuelle) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, Arrayappend(a_ValeurActuelle, a_ValeurAjouter)) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_ValeurAjouter) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIIx_AppendVar(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As Variant, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Variant Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVar = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As String Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVarString = True Exit Function
